tagline: Get calendar updates in Slack and manage meetings from chat
metaTitle: Google Calendar + Slack Integration: Meeting Reminders
metaDescription: Get meeting reminders and a daily schedule digest in Slack, with your status set from your calendar. GAIA follows up on meeting notes too. See the setup steps.
intro: Your calendar and your team chat should work together, but they operate independently. Meetings start and nobody was reminded in Slack. Your status shows as Available while you're in back-to-back calls. Colleagues don't know when to reach you versus when you're heads-down. GAIA synchronizes Google Calendar with Slack so your team always has accurate context about your availability.

useCases.title: Automatic Slack status from calendar
useCases.description: GAIA sets your status to 'In a meeting' with the meeting name during calendar events and clears it when the event ends, keeping your team informed without manual status updates.

useCases.title: Meeting reminders in Slack
useCases.description: GAIA sends DMs five minutes before each meeting with the join link, agenda, and attendee list so you're always prepared and never scrambling for the video call link.

useCases.title: Daily schedule digest
useCases.description: GAIA posts your day's schedule to your personal DM each morning so you can plan your focus time and know when you have back-to-back meetings coming.

useCases.title: Meeting notes follow-up
useCases.description: After a meeting ends, GAIA sends a message prompting you to capture notes and action items while the context is fresh, with a quick link to your preferred note-taking app.

useCases.title: Team availability sharing
useCases.description: GAIA can post a team's combined availability from Google Calendar to a channel so scheduling group meetings doesn't require round-robin calendar checking.

howItWorks.step: Connect Google Calendar and Slack to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your calendar and your workspace. If managing team availability, each team member connects their own calendar.
Choose which calendar event types trigger status changes, which reminders to receive, and what information to include in meeting prep notifications.

howItWorks.step: GAIA keeps status and schedule in sync
howItWorks.description: From the moment you connect, GAIA keeps your status accurate and your team informed about your availability without any ongoing manual effort.

faqs.question: Can GAIA differentiate between important and routine meetings for status changes?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can configure which calendar event types trigger status changes. You might set 'Focus time' blocks to show as 'Do Not Disturb' while optional meetings don't change your status at all.

faqs.question: Does GAIA share meeting details publicly or only in DMs?
faqs.answer: By default, meeting details are sent only to your personal DM. You can configure team availability sharing for specific channels, but individual meeting content stays private.

faqs.question: Can GAIA help schedule meetings from Slack?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can message GAIA to find a time for a meeting with specific people, and it will check every attendee's calendar availability and propose times.
